name: What kind of paint do you use for interior projects?

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint do you use for interior projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: We primarily use high-quality, durable, and low-VOC (Volatile Organic Compound) paints from reputable brands. The specific type of paint – such as matte, eggshell, satin, or semi-gloss – will be selected based on the room's function, desired aesthetic, and durability requirements. For example, higher-sheen paints are often recommended for kitchens and bathrooms due to their moisture resistance and ease of cleaning. We discuss paint options with you to meet your project's needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: We use high-quality, durable, and low-VOC paints from reputable brands, selected based on the room's function and your desired finish.
